invariants.rationale: The method explicitly throws an exception if actor is null, so actor must be non-null at exit.
The result reflects whether actor is this.actor (then delegates to the superclass), or false otherwise.
If actor is not this.actor, the method always returns false.
When actor matches, result is determined by the outcome of the superclass's removeActor.
If result is false, actor must not be this.actor; if result is true, actor was this.actor and superclass succeeded.
